chapter: New York, Henderson and Charlie Johnson
title: Charlie Johnson's personnel at Small's Paradise
summary: He lists the band: Benny Waters, Bobby and Howard Johnson, Lonnie Simmons, Billy Taylor, Ralph Storey, with Roane first trumpet, Autrey second, Frankie Newton and Babe from Baltimore.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So everything was fine, and Charlie had a doggone good band, you know. He had Benny Waters on Tenor sax. He had Johnson -- Bobbie Johnson on guitar. He had -- uh, uh -- I'm trying to -- he had Bobbie Johnson's brother on sax -- let's see, what's his name? Gooseneck, we used to call him.
Yeah, he plays piano, and -- in the -- and saxaphone there. Bobbie Johnson and -- Howard Johnson.
Yeah. Lonnie -- what's his name? He's a tenor saxaphone player too. He was in there. Lonnie Johnson -- Lonnie -- Lonnie Simmons.
Yeah. Oh, Billy Taylor on bass. Old man Billy Taylor, and what a bass man, you know.
Who were the trombones, do you remember?

Yes. Hmm, yeah. Story, Story from Kentucky, Ralph Story? What was his name? Paducah? Used to call him -- his nickname was Paducah, Paducah, Kentucky, that's where he's -- that was his home. And he played trombone. What was Paducah's name? Doggone it, that's why I can't think of his name that way, because of Paducah. That's where he was from, that's the name -- was Paducah, Kentucky.
Ah, Ralph Storey, that could be. Yeah.
Yeah, Ralph Storey. It had to be, yeah.
Yeah, Ralph Storey. But what a band! Yeah, what a band it was. And I was working there with them, and of course I'll tell you about the trumpet player. I -- uh -- with the buzz mute.
Yeah, and Babe -- Babe from Baltimore. Babe -- uh, it's a heck of a -- another heck of a trumpet player. I forgot Babe's name, but that was a band.
Were you playing first trumpet with the band?
I was playing second, and they brought Babe in, and Babe was playing in there, and we used to swap the -- you know, concerts. I mean the solos and stuff. And --
